announcement.title: Nexora 1.1.0 现已发布
announcement.body:
欢迎升级到 Nexora 1.1.0！本轮更新重点打磨了公告与更新弹窗的动效表现、长文本排版与拉取安全性：

1. 弹窗新增入场与关闭动效
公告与更新弹窗现支持柔和浮现与轻快淡出过渡；在 Nexora 或 macOS 设置中开启「减少动态效果」时，会自动切换为简洁的淡入淡出。

2. 长公告排版与操作按钮优化
较长的公告内容可在 Liquid Glass 弹窗内流畅滚动，底部操作按钮始终固定可见；较长的链接按钮支持最多两行换行显示，鼠标悬停即可查看完整文字。

3. 更稳健的公告源大小校验
在流式读取公告内容时实时限制 64 KiB 上限，即使服务端未返回 Content-Length 也能可靠防护。

可在「设置 → 关于 → 检查更新」升级至 1.1.0，或点击下方查看完整更新日志。

en.title: Nexora 1.1.0 Is Now Available
en.body:
Welcome to Nexora 1.1.0! This update refines the animations, layout, and feed handling for in-app announcement and update dialogs:

1. Smoother Dialog Transitions
Announcement and update dialogs now lift gently into place on presentation and close with a shorter fade. Enabling Reduce Motion in Nexora or macOS switches both transitions to a simple fade.

2. Improved Long-Announcement Layout
Longer announcements now scroll smoothly inside the Liquid Glass dialog while keeping the action buttons visible at the bottom. Long action labels wrap onto a second line, with the full text shown on hover.

3. Bounded Announcement Feed Reads
Nexora now enforces the 64 KiB payload limit while reading the announcement feed, including when the server omits Content-Length.

Open Settings → About → Check for Updates to upgrade to 1.1.0, or view the full release notes below.
